title: Actions, states and time: introductory contrasts

relationships.label: ている: ongoing action, resulting state or repeated activity

exercises.translation: I brush my teeth before going to bed. Use 寝る (ねる, go to bed) and the 前に pattern; fill the complete phrase.
exercises.evidence: The instruction specifies both the temporal relation and the construction to practise.
exercises.explanation: 前に takes the dictionary form 寝る. The brushing precedes going to bed.

options.label: 寝る前に

exercises.prompt: 「京都に行ったことがあります。」→____。
exercises.translation: I have been to Kyoto. Identify the explicit grammatical framing: 経験 (けいけん: たことがある, having an experience) or 出来事 (できごと, an ordinary finite past-event report).
exercises.evidence: Judge the construction actually used, not whether the event could also count as someone's experience.
exercises.explanation: たことがある explicitly frames prior experience. A finite past report narrates an event; the two statements can both be true.

options.label: 経験
options.rationale: This matches the explicit grammatical framing.

options.label: 出来事
options.rationale: This does not match the explicit grammatical framing.
